diffuseAlbedo.note: Mona marble, Anglesey: a green serpentinite breccia; no measured colour was read: a first value read from trade and museum photographs of the named material (as the Oxford University Museum's shafts show it).

refractiveIndex.source: Amgueddfa Cymru, Mineralogy of Wales database, 'Antigorite': the serpentinized rocks of the New Harbour Group, Anglesey, 'were once referred to as Mona Marble'; antigorite SW of Llanfechell; Maltman (1977) mentions antigorite with lizardite in serpentinite from Holy Island. https://museum.wales/mineralogy-of-wales/database/?mineral=15&name=Antigorite . Handbook of Mineralogy 'Antigorite' (alpha 1.558-1.567, beta 1.565, gamma 1.562-1.574) https://www.handbookofmineralogy.org/pdfs/antigorite.pdf and 'Lizardite' (alpha 1.538-1.554, beta and gamma 1.546-1.560) https://www.handbookofmineralogy.org/pdfs/lizardite.pdf
refractiveIndex.note: Checked: all the indices and museum statements are as cited, and the arithmetic holds. The equal weighting is an assumption. The museum page records the two serpentines together only in Holy Island serpentinite, which is New Harbour Group, and gives no proportions. Calcite or dolomite in the veins and breccia matrix (n about 1.60) is left out. A carbonate-rich shaft would read higher. If a shaft is known to be antigorite-only, 1.565 applies.

porosity.note: A first open porosity for the rock type; no measurement of this stone was read.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows at gallery distance.

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows: its bedding, veining or banding.

bedAspect.note: How much longer the structure runs along its bedding than across it.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
